description: Defines the FileSystemMonitor class with platform-specific implementations (Linux and Windows) for monitoring file system changes, including observer pattern for callbacks, resource management, and event handling.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Platform-specific class for monitoring file system changes, with nested classes for callback handling, resource management, and threading.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to be notified of file system updates.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Observer
classes.description: Linux-specific class managing callbacks for a monitored file or directory.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Context
classes.description: Windows-specific class managing directory change notifications and callback invocation.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Dispatcher
classes.description: Thread class for processing file system events on Windows.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is properly initialized.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific file or directory.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for a specific file or directory.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the event to process file system changes (Windows).
